[\"[[O0]]主要结论：[[C0]] 在 vLLM 和 SGLang 上记录.en: [[O0]]Main findings:[[C0]] Record TTFT, output token intervals, throughput, and cache-related metrics on vLLM and SGLang. Synthetic workloads need to retain the prefix structure; merely matching input-output length will lose cache behavior. The data measures model-request serving, separate from final task evaluation.

[\"[[O0]]主张与研究方法：[[C0]] 从种子工作流出发，把提示词、模型.en: [[O0]]Claims and research methods:[[C0]] Starting from seed workflows, divide prompts, models, topologies, and tool strategies into multiple optimization dimensions. Multiple independent coding agents experiment within a limited scope, then the integrated agent modifies combinations based on the development set results and component traces. Finally, measure quality, inference cost, and latency on a held-out set.

[\"[[O0]]主要结论：[[C0]] 论文覆盖 AppWorld、LiveC.en: [[O0]]Main findings:[[C0]] The paper covers AppWorld, LiveCodeBench, AgentDojo, PostTrainBench v1.1. Compared to Meta-Harness, the authors report an average deployment latency reduction of 42.45%, cost reduction of 4.30%, and task score increase of 2.58 percentage points. The one-time optimization cost for finding solutions increases by an average of 17.98%. Deployment benefits and search overhead are measured separately.
